about: Real Tesseract.js 5.1.1 words for 30 synthetic, computer-rendered GST bills from a third independent review (new layouts: phone lists, international landlines, bank and pay tables, two-column bank blocks, handwriting-like fonts), positions measured at the screenshot scale, with ground truth.
